## Functions
```{r}
compare_control_enu <- function(data) {
  # Ensure the 'data' argument is a dataframe
  if (!is.data.frame(data)) {
    stop("Input must be a dataframe.")
  }

  # Check if necessary columns exist
  required_columns <- c("name", "mle", "cilow", "cihigh", "list_name")
  if (!all(required_columns %in% names(data))) {
    stop("Dataframe must contain the following columns: ", paste(required_columns, collapse=", "))
  }

  # Function to calculate standard error from confidence intervals
  calc_se <- function(cilow, cihigh) {
    (cihigh - cilow) / (2 * 1.96)
  }

  # Adding standard errors to the data frame
  data$se <- mapply(calc_se, data$cilow, data$cihigh)

  # Function to calculate Z score and raw p-value
  compare_groups <- function(group1, group2) {
    difference_in_means <- group1$mle - group2$mle
    se_combined <- sqrt(group1$se^2 + group2$se^2)
    z_score <- difference_in_means / se_combined
    p_value <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z_score)))
    return(p_value)
  }

  # Compare control vs enu for each name and store results
  comparison_results <- data.frame(name = character(), p_value = numeric())
  for (name in unique(data$name)) {
    control_group <- data[data$name == name & data$list_name == "control", ]
    enu_group <- data[data$name == name & data$list_name == "enu", ]
    if (nrow(control_group) == 1 && nrow(enu_group) == 1) {
      p_value <- compare_groups(control_group, enu_group)
      comparison_results <- rbind(comparison_results, data.frame(name = name, p_value = p_value))
    }
  }

  # Adjusting p-values for multiple comparisons
  comparison_results$adjusted_p_value <- p.adjust(comparison_results$p_value, method = "bonferroni")

  # Return the results
  return(comparison_results)
}

compare_condition_cycles <- function(data) {
  # Ensure the 'data' argument is a dataframe
  if (!is.data.frame(data)) {
    stop("Input must be a dataframe.")
  }

  # Check if necessary columns exist
  required_columns <- c("name", "mle", "cilow", "cihigh", "condition_cycle")
  if (!all(required_columns %in% names(data))) {
    stop("Dataframe must contain the following columns: ", paste(required_columns, collapse=", "))
  }

  # Function to calculate standard error from confidence intervals
  calc_se <- function(cilow, cihigh) {
    (cihigh - cilow) / (2 * 1.96)
  }

  # Adding standard errors to the data frame
  data$se <- mapply(calc_se, data$cilow, data$cihigh)

  # Function to calculate Z score and raw p-value
  compare_groups <- function(group1, group2) {
    difference_in_means <- group1$mle - group2$mle
    se_combined <- sqrt(group1$se^2 + group2$se^2)
    z_score <- difference_in_means / se_combined
    p_value <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z_score)))
    return(p_value)
  }

  # Compare all pairs of condition_cycles for each name and store results
  comparison_results <- data.frame(name = character(), 
                                   condition_cycle1 = character(), 
                                   condition_cycle2 = character(), 
                                   p_value = numeric())
  unique_names <- unique(data$name)
  unique_condition_cycles <- unique(data$condition_cycle)

  for (name in unique_names) {
    for (i in 1:(length(unique_condition_cycles) - 1)) {
      for (j in (i + 1):length(unique_condition_cycles)) {
        group1 <- data[data$name == name & data$condition_cycle == unique_condition_cycles[i], ]
        group2 <- data[data$name == name & data$condition_cycle == unique_condition_cycles[j], ]
        if (nrow(group1) == 1 && nrow(group2) == 1) {
          p_value <- compare_groups(group1, group2)
          comparison_results <- rbind(comparison_results, 
                                      data.frame(name = name, 
                                                 condition_cycle1 = unique_condition_cycles[i], 
                                                 condition_cycle2 = unique_condition_cycles[j], 
                                                 p_value = p_value))
        }
      }
    }
  }

  # Adjusting p-values for multiple comparisons
  comparison_results$adjusted_p_value <- p.adjust(comparison_results$p_value, method = "bonferroni")

  # Return the results
  return(comparison_results)
}

theme_Publication <- function(base_size=16, base_family="helvetica") {
      library(grid)
      library(ggthemes)
      (theme_foundation(base_size=base_size, base_family = "")
       + theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold",
                                         size = rel(1.2), hjust = 0.5),
               text = element_text(),
               panel.background = element_rect(colour = NA),
               plot.background = element_rect(colour = NA),
               panel.border = element_rect(colour = NA),
               axis.title = element_text(face = "bold",size = rel(1)),
               axis.title.y = element_text(angle=90,vjust =2),
               axis.title.x = element_text(vjust = -0.2),
               axis.text = element_text(), 
               axis.line = element_line(colour="black"),
               axis.ticks = element_line(),
               panel.grid.major = element_line(colour="#f0f0f0"),
               panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
               legend.key = element_rect(colour = NA),
               legend.position = "bottom",
               legend.direction = "horizontal",
               #legend.key.size= unit(0.2, "cm"),
               legend.margin = unit(0, "cm"),
               legend.title = element_text(face="italic"),
               plot.margin=unit(c(10,5,5,5),"mm"),
               strip.background=element_rect(colour="#f0f0f0",fill="#f0f0f0"),
               strip.text = element_text(face="bold")
          ))
      
}

grlist_to_dataframe <- function(gr_list) {
  # Use lapply to iterate over GRangesList and perform operations
  df_list <- lapply(seq_along(gr_list), function(i) {
    gr <- gr_list[[i]]
    data.frame(
      sampleID = names(gr_list)[i],
      chr = as.character(seqnames(gr)),
      pos = start(ranges(gr)),
      ref = as.character(gr$REF),
      mut = as.character(gr$ALT)
    )
  })
  
  # Combine all the data frames into a single data frame using do.call and rbind
  combined_df <- do.call(rbind, df_list)

  return(combined_df)
}

# function to convert to dataframe in correct format
grlist_to_dataframe_old <- function(gr_list) {
  # Initialize an empty list to store the data frames
  df_list <- list()
  
  # Loop over each GRanges object in the GRangesList
  for (i in seq_along(gr_list)) {
    # Extract the ith GRanges object
    gr <- gr_list[[i]]
    
    # Convert the GRanges object to a data frame
    df <- data.frame(
      chr = as.character(seqnames(gr)),
      pos = ranges(gr)@start,
      ref = sapply(gr$REF, as.character),
      mut = sapply(gr$ALT, as.character)
    )
    
    # Add sampleID column
    df$sampleID <- names(gr_list)[i]
    
    # Append to the list
    df_list[[i]] <- df
  }
  
  # Combine all the data frames into a single data frame
  combined_df <- do.call(rbind, df_list)
  combined_df <- combined_df[,c(5,1,2,3,4)] # make sampleID first column
  return(combined_df)
}


test_mean_significance <- function(mean, lower_limit, upper_limit, sample_size) {
  # Calculate the standard error from the confidence interval
  standard_error <- (upper_limit - lower_limit) / (2 * 1.96)
  
  # Calculate the t statistic
  t_statistic <- mean / standard_error
  
  # Calculate degrees of freedom
  df <- sample_size - 1
  
  # Calculate the p-value
  p_value <- 2 * pt(-abs(t_statistic), df)
  
  # Return a list containing the t statistic, the p-value, and whether the mean is significantly different from 0
  significantly_different <- p_value < 0.05
  return(list(t_statistic = t_statistic, p_value = p_value, significantly_different = significantly_different))
}

wrap_labels <- function(labels, width = 5) {
  wrapped_labels <- str_wrap(labels, width)
  names(wrapped_labels) <- names(labels)
  return(wrapped_labels)
}

average_simulation_list <- function(simulation.list) {
  # Replace Inf with 0 in numeric columns
  simulation.list.cleaned <- lapply(simulation.list, function(df) {
    nums <- sapply(df, is.numeric)  # Identify numeric columns
    df[nums] <- lapply(df[nums], function(column) {
      replace(column, is.infinite(column), 0)  # Replace Inf with 0
    })
    return(df)
  })
  
  # Identify numeric columns (assuming the first dataframe structure represents all others)
  numeric_columns <- sapply(simulation.list.cleaned[[1]], is.numeric)
  
  # Filter out non-numeric columns for summing and averaging
  simulation.list.cleaned.numeric <- lapply(simulation.list.cleaned, function(df) df[, numeric_columns])
  
  # Sum numeric columns across all data frames
  simulation.list.cleaned.numeric.sum <- Reduce("+", simulation.list.cleaned.numeric)
  
  # Calculate averages
  simulation.list.cleaned.numeric.avg <- simulation.list.cleaned.numeric.sum / length(simulation.list.cleaned)
  
  # Add back the non-numeric data (assuming it's identical across all data frames and taking it from the first one)
  simulation.list.cleaned.numeric.avg <- cbind(simulation.list[[1]][, !numeric_columns, drop = FALSE], simulation.list.cleaned.numeric.avg)
  
  return(simulation.list.cleaned.numeric.avg)
}
```

# Global dN/dS estimates
- wmis = missense
- wnon = nonsense
- wspl = essential splice site mutations
- wtru = truncating substitutions
- wall = all non-synonymous substitutions
